youtube_description:
In this interview Finn Tarp, Director of UNU-WIDER, speaks about his work on aid and development and the role aid can play in the future. He argues that over the last 30 years aid has in general had a positive effect on growth and development. 

More about the work of Finn Tarp can be found at https://www.wider.unu.edu/expert/finn-tarp.
